description: This file implements an AWS SQS logging integration class 'SQSLogger' that batches and sends log entries to an SQS queue, with support for encryption and health checks.

classes.name: SQSLogger
classes.description: A batching logger that sends log entries to an AWS SQS queue, with optional encryption and health check capabilities.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SQSLogger with configuration parameters, sets up HTTP client, and starts periodic flushing.

methods.name: _init_sqs_params
methods.description: Sets up SQS parameters, handles environment variable substitution, and initializes encryption if enabled.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Handles successful log events by appending payloads to the queue, with optional base64 stripping.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Handles failed log events similarly to success events, with exception logging.

methods.name: async_send_batch
methods.description: Sends the current batch of log payloads asynchronously to SQS.

methods.name: async_send_message
methods.description: Sends a single log payload to SQS, handling AWS request signing and optional encryption.

methods.name: async_health_check
methods.description: Performs a health check by attempting to send a test message to the SQS queue.
